title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 82422 Cadiz Jewett Road in Cadiz, Ohio, as the John Armor Bingham Post Office.
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 82422 Cadiz Jewett Road in Cadiz, Ohio, as the John Armor Bingham Post Office.

summary.headline: Congress renamed the Cadiz, Ohio, post office after John Armor Bingham, a 19th-century congressman.
summary.what_it_does: This law officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 82422 Cadiz Jewett Road in Cadiz, Ohio, the John Armor Bingham Post Office. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, hours, or rules.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 27, 2022.
